annotation.authors_or_issuer: National AI Office, Ministry of Digital Malaysia
key_provisions_or_claims: Targets AI Nation aspiration by 2030 under RMK-13
Five foundational enablers including trust via responsible governance
Six catalytic initiatives to deliver impact within 18 months
AI governance framework published for public syndication, including an AI Act, then an AI Governance Act launched
Impact engines across economic and societal sectors
annotation.summary_en: Draft Malaysia National AI Action Plan 2030, circulated for public feedback (survey closing 30 November 2025). It sets an 'AI Nation' vision with impact engines, five foundational enablers including trust via responsible governance, and six catalytic initiatives, including publishing an AI governance framework and AI Act. No robotics content.
